newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Unit of Indonesia's Sinar Mas announces bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Unit of Indonesia's Sinar Mas announces bond issue.

text.p: Indonesia's PT Pindo Deli Pulp & Paper Mills, a unit of the Sinar Mas Group, announced on Tuesday a 200 billion rupiah straight bond issue to partly finance a $825 million expansion programme.

"The proposed five-year bond issue is expected to be on offer in early January next year and scheduled to be listed on the Surabaya stock exchange in late January," vice president director Suresh Kilam told reporters.
Kilam said the coupon rate would be fixed later, but said it was likely to range between 18 percent and 18.25 percent.

Around 90 percent of the proceeds would be used to partly finance Pindo's current expansion programme, which was expected to increase its annual paper production capacity to 860,000 tonnes from the current 210,000 tonnes.
The remaining 10 percent would be used for working capital purposes, Kilam said.
Kilam said the company expected to gradually begin commercial production from the new expansion capacity in the first quarter of 1997.
In addition to the bond issue, Pindo plans to finance the $825 million expansion programme through a combination of bank loans, export credits and funds generated by the firm, Kilam said.
Pindo expects to post net sales of 700 billion rupiah in 1996 against 516.7 billion rupiah in 1995, he said.
